UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated founder profile and login audit timestamps.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

email.description: Verified email address from Google Sign-In.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when user record was first created.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent sign-in.

VentureWorkspace.title: VentureWorkspace
VentureWorkspace.description: Owner-isolated NEXUS Venture Studio root workspace storing Venture Profile, Stages 1-4 (Competition & Positioning, Revenue & Pricing, Market Size & Demand, Go-to-Market), and extension anchors for modular subcollection stages.

activeStage.description: Current active core studio stage (1 to 5).

schemaVersion.description: Workspace envelope schema version for forward-compatible module migrations (optional for v1 documents).

activeModuleId.description: Optional identifier of the currently active venture module (core or future subcollection module).

ventureProfile.description: Selected venture profile (name, targetCustomer, problem, geography, offer, createdAt, updatedAt, and Session 11 fields).

competitionPositioning.description: Session 11 competitor research, positioning axes/scores, positioning statement, AI Strategy Challenge responses/feedback, and Competition War Room results.

revenuePricing.description: Stage 2 Revenue & Pricing Lab inputs, 3 manual scenarios, pricing decision, evidence, assumptions, and calculated outputs.

marketSizeDemand.description: Stage 3 Market Size & Demand Lab market definition, TAM/SAM/SOM counts & values, annual spend, demand checks, assumptions, and evidence.

goToMarket.description: Stage 4 Go-to-Market Launch Lab segment, messaging, up to 3 channels, conversion/CAC metrics, 30-day experiment plan, and GTM synthesis.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when venture workspace was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest workspace save.

VentureModule.title: VentureModule
VentureModule.description: Extendable subcollection document storing an individual future venture module (e.g. MVP Brief, Feature Prioritization, No-Code Tool Selection, UX & Customer Journey, AI Feature Design, API & Data Flow, Prototype Build, Usability Testing, MVP Evidence Review, Projected Financial Statements, Operating Model, HR & Founder Organisation, CAC / LTV / Burn / Runway, Legal Structure, Labour / IP / Data Risk, Government & Policy Risk) linked to the parent venture.

moduleId.description: Canonical module slug matching document ID (e.g. mvp-brief, feature-prioritization, legal-structure).

status.description: Lifecycle state of this module within the venture.

inputs.description: Structured user-entered fields specific to this module.

outputs.description: Calculated outputs, metrics, and synthesized deliverables for this module.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions and validation gaps tracked inside this module.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence, citations, and test artefacts for this module.

aiChallenges.description: Bounded list (max 50) of AI Strategy Challenge critiques specific to this module.

completedAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when module reached completed state.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when module document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest module update.

VentureModuleEntry.title: VentureModuleEntry
VentureModuleEntry.description: Optional repeatable record inside a VentureModule (such as individual usability test sessions, prioritized feature cards, financial statement line items, or compliance risk items) so modules never hit the 1 MB Firestore document limit.

entryType.description: Discriminator for the record kind within the module (e.g. feature, usability-test, financial-row, risk-item).

orderIndex.description: Optional sort index for ordered entries.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest entry update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/ventures/{ventureId}.description: Private venture workspace root document owned strictly by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/ventures/{ventureId}/mod.description: Extendable module documents attached to the same venture for Product/MVP, Financial/Operating, and Legal/Policy modules.
Scalable repeating records belonging to a specific venture module.
